questions.question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

I am sure my mother has something that you shall wear in the evening.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the singular form of the verb 'shall wear' is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be **'can wear'** or **'will wear'** to indicate future ability or certainty.

Hence, the correct statement is "***I am sure my mother has something that you can wear__ in the evening*."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• In English grammar, the modal verb **'shall'** is less commonly used in modern English and is often replaced by **'will'** or **'can'** depending on the context.
 
• **'Shall'** is typically used to express a strong intention or a formal command, which is not suitable in the given sentence context.
